finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers get human onboarding help and Slack-based support without needing a credit card to start.

quote.text: ✓ No card required · Guided setup · Human support on Slack

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers should expect 24/7 Slack support to apply only while their account remains active.

quote.text: support@clickmoat.com · 24/7 support via Slack for active customers

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers cannot compare the deal to a standard monthly price because ClickMoat has not published one yet.

quote.text: Do you publish monthly pricing? Not yet. ClickMoat is currently focused on supporting existing customers and validating the next subscription model.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers get production-ready protection for Google Ads only, with Meta and other platforms not yet live.

quote.text: Today’s public story is Google Ads first. Meta is labelled as coming soon until the launch is ready.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers get an extra visibility and documentation layer, not a replacement for Google's own invalid-traffic filtering.

quote.text: No. ClickMoat is an additional visibility and protection layer for your paid traffic workflow. It helps your team investigate signals, manage rules, and document suspicious activity.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to ClickMoat
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to ClickMoat
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The exhibit only says the vendor is validating a future subscription model for other customers, which does not show lifetime deal buyers are being charged or moved off lifetime access, and no defense exhibit confirms the term.

exhibits.quote: Not yet. ClickMoat is currently focused on supporting existing customers and validating the next subscription model.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor admits a future subscription model is still being validated.

trials.claim: Plan 3 includes unlimited ad spend per month

- 15 Google Ad accounts
- 10 protected websites

- Unlimited total ad clicks per month
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either supporting or contradicting unlimited monthly ad spend on Plan 3.

trials.claimQuote:
- Stack up to 3 codes
- 1 Google Ad account
- 1 protected website
- Up to $5K ad spend per month
trials.reasoning: One buyer's report of an internal error when connecting a Google account is a single support issue and does not prove Plan 1 does not include 1 Google Ad account.

exhibits.quote: Just signed up. i installed everything but my google account wont connect to Moat. it keeps saying when i click in it that there is an internal error.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the included Google Ad account cannot actually be connected due to internal error.

trials.claimQuote:
- 1 Google Ad account
- 1 protected website
- Up to $5K ad spend per month
- 100,000 total ad clicks per month
trials.reasoning: One buyer's report that tracking code broke page loading does not prove Plan 1 does not include 1 protected website, and no defense exhibit confirms the inclusion.

exhibits.quote: We followed the instructions to install the tracking code on our landing pages, but it caused the pages to stop loading for new visitors.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports protecting a website broke landing pages and stopped them loading for new visitors.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes all future Pro Plan updates
trials.claimQuote:
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Pro Plan updates
- Stack up to 3 codes
trials.reasoning: The review only says buyers purchased based on a promise of Meta ad protection; it does not directly show that future Pro Plan updates were denied to Plan 1 buyers.

exhibits.quote: Many of us purchased higher LTD tiers specifically based on the promise of Meta ad protection.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports future promised functionality that motivated higher-tier purchases has not been delivered.
